_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: The scenario shall import representative workflow exports, replace every client credential and sensitive value with scoped synthetic stand-ins, execute through an engine adapter against simulator behavior derived from published API descriptions or recorded exchanges without hand-written per-workflow stubs or real-client access, and retain an auditable run record.
requirements.title: Safe synthetic rehearsal

validation.notes: [REQ:CR-P0-001] Proves n8n export normalization strips credential-shaped source values, rejects unsupported executable nodes, and fingerprints only operation structure.
[REQ:CR-P0-001] Proves the typed simulator returns description-derived synthetic responses and applies a deterministic transient fault without network access.
[REQ:CR-P0-001] Proves fault/retry evidence is retained and execution remains unapproved until an explicit human decision.

requirements.description: Rehearse thirty unlike public community workflows spanning webhook, schedule, polling, sub-workflow, error-workflow, large-payload, and community-node cases; repair ten seeded defects and retain evidence and a handoff for each.
requirements.title: Generic coverage and repair

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:CR-P1-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The scenario shall import and run one client-shaped workflow using synthetic Gmail, Sheets, and CRM services from import through recorded handoff in one sitting.
requirements.title: Client-shaped Gmail, Sheets, and CRM handoff

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:CR-P0-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The scenario shall redo A1 in Make and A2–A3 in their requested tools with made-up data, retaining source-backed handoffs without creating real messages or client state.
requirements.title: Named-tool A1–A3 rehearsal handoffs

requirements.description: The scenario shall derive reusable simulated service behavior from published API descriptions or recorded exchanges without hand-written stubs for individual workflows.
